title: Nā ʻUhane Māhoe Huki Pū i ke Ola
explanation:
# Two-Sentence Summary

Two spiral galaxies 200 million light-years away are locked in a slow-motion cosmic collision that will eventually merge into one, triggering a spectacular burst of new star formation as their gas clouds violently collide and compress. Named "The Twin Spirits Pulling Together Creating Life" by Hawaiian high school students, this breathtaking image captures galaxies in the process of creating the chemical elements—carbon, oxygen, iron—that form the foundation for planets and life itself.
